record.source: Johannes Rauber, Sulzer Chemtech Ltd., Design Practice for Packed Liquid-Liquid Extraction Columns, AIChE 2006 — preliminary screening characteristics only
record.vendorNotes: Efficiency / Back-Mixing Preferred family (published screening throughput 35–60 m³/(m²·h), NTS ≤ 10, up to 3 beds). Preliminary screening record — controlled literature characteristics (Johannes Rauber, Sulzer Chemtech Ltd., Design Practice for Packed Liquid-Liquid Extraction Columns, AIChE 2006 — preliminary screening characteristics only). Replace with a vendor-certified record before any rating use.

voidFraction.sourceReference: Generic structured sheet-metal packing literature-typical value, Assumed — NOT Sulzer-certified vendor data

specificSurfaceArea.sourceReference: Packing designation: "250" is the nominal specific-surface-area grade (250 m²/m³) of the SMV/SMVP families, not a physical element dimension; within the published 200–500 m²/m³ SSA screening range (Johannes Rauber, Sulzer Chemtech Ltd., Design Practice for Packed Liquid-Liquid Extraction Columns, AIChE 2006 — preliminary screening characteristics only)
